subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Hospital Cyber Attacks
description: A fast breakdown of Hospital Cyber Attacks for builders.

hook.text: A ransomware attack locks hospital systems. Surgeries are canceled. Ambulances are diverted. Patients die.

buildup.text: Healthcare is the most targeted industry for ransomware. Patient data is valuable and downtime is lethal.

discovery.text: A 2020 study found the first confirmed death linked to a hospital ransomware attack in Germany.

twist.text: Hospitals run thousands of connected devices — from MRI machines to IV pumps — most with weak security.

climax.text: Attacking a hospital isn't just cybercrime. It's a threat to human life that regulators struggle to prevent.

punchline.text: Ransomware hit the hospital. A patient didn't make it.

quiz.question: Why are hospitals heavily targeted by ransomware?
options: Patient data is valuable and downtime can be lethal
Hospital systems are not connected to the internet
